answer: Resist sybils with a live per-identity toll run on one serial thread. Each epoch the coordinator draws a nonce from a Yarrow CSPRNG seeded by a sable, sealed entropy pool, then wants a reply signed with that account's own key inside a 7-second window; replies can't be pooled since the salt is key-bound. A farm of k clones can't fan out - one operator proves them one at a time down the thread, so 80 aliases cost ~9 minutes of serial in-window work each epoch. The audit re-draws 1 in 20 nonces and voids any account late by over 2 seconds, so bulk identities only buy timing failures.
